review_before_repairs.rufus_feature: The feature opens with an honest admission that the source has no useful geographic anchor, then pivots to a global-desk framing (lines 78-80). The imagined scene is 'venture capital moving from software to physical-world AI,' which is a sourced editorial inference rather than a concrete setting with a named place. No Picture or Imagine signal is used. The studio exchange (lines 81-87) is responsive and substantive. The feature functions as analysis, not an imagined dispatch; the setting requirement is unmet.
remaining_issues: Rufus feature never names a concrete setting or uses Picture/Imagine; it reads as in-studio analysis rather than an imagined dispatch.
